CommunityApplications.Profile: Cantinarr is one app over your whole media stack. The people in your house browse, request movies, TV, and books, and get a push notification when something is ready. You get everything behind that: Radarr, Sonarr, and Chaptarr, your download clients, Tautulli activity, and Plex invites. [br][br] This repository holds its Unraid Community Applications template. The application itself lives at https://github.com/windoze95/cantinarr and the template is updated from there whenever a port, volume, or environment variable changes. [br][br] Report problems at https://github.com/windoze95/cantinarr/issues . Feature requests go to https://cantinarr.com/roadmap/ , no account needed.
